Actual Article Body:
Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. published an extensive diatribe on social media on Friday denouncing radical Islam and calling on Michigan Democratic Senate nominee Abdul el Sayed to condemn the Muslim Brotherhood.

The more than 3,700-word X post came after Kennedy was strongly rebuked by legacy media outlets and the el Sayed campaign for statements he made in Michigan on behalf of Republican challenger, former Rep. Mike Rogers.
